Source.evidence_source: [/page/6/Text/10] 23 of the 28 subjects completed the four self-report measures and the CDRS-R. Follow-up interviews were completed by the graduate student who served as the interviewer at posttesting. Subjects were paid $5 for completing the assessment package. Mothers were again contacted and asked to complete the CBCL within 3 days.
